entities.name: Other configuration
entities.description: RRC configuration container that includes various UE assistance and reporting configurations for power saving, measurement reporting, and other features.

entities.name: Delay budget reporting configuration
entities.description: Configures whether the UE should send delay budget reports for power saving optimization.

entities.name: Overheating assistance configuration
entities.description: Configures whether the UE should provide overheating assistance information to the network.

entities.name: IDC assistance configuration
entities.description: Configures whether the UE should provide in-device coexistence assistance information.

entities.name: DRX preference configuration
entities.description: Configures whether the UE should provide its preference on DRX parameters for power saving.

entities.name: Timer T342
entities.description: Timer associated with delay budget reporting configuration.

entities.name: Timer T345
entities.description: Timer associated with overheating assistance configuration.

entities.name: Configuration set to setup
entities.description: Condition where a configuration parameter is set to 'setup', enabling the corresponding UE behavior.

entities.name: Configuration not set to setup
entities.description: Condition where a configuration parameter is not set to 'setup', disabling the corresponding UE behavior.

entities.name: UE delay budget reporting
entities.description: UE behavior of sending delay budget reports for power saving optimization.

entities.name: UE overheating assistance
entities.description: UE behavior of providing overheating assistance information to the network.

relations.description: Other configuration may contain delay budget reporting configuration.
Other configuration may contain overheating assistance configuration.
Other configuration may contain IDC assistance configuration.
Other configuration may contain DRX preference configuration.
Delay budget reporting configuration behavior is guarded by setup condition.
Delay budget reporting configuration behavior is guarded by not-setup condition.
Setup condition establishes UE delay budget reporting behavior.
Not-setup condition stops timer T342 if running.
Overheating assistance configuration behavior is guarded by setup condition.
Overheating assistance configuration behavior is guarded by not-setup condition.
Setup condition establishes UE overheating assistance behavior.
Not-setup condition stops timer T345 if running.
